### Abby Paulos, PhD

<div class="person-role">Principal Investigator</div>

Assistant Professor of Epidemiology  
University of Michigan School of Public Health

Abby studies environmental and cross-species transmission of infectious diseases, environmental pathogen surveillance, and One Health epidemiology.

[Email](contact.qmd) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hB8EjpgAAAAJ&hl=en&authuser=1) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-9258-6648)
